So we can pick the appropriate template that matches carbonyl-ene. Which of the two is correct? The first template seems to involve silicon and a ketone to alcohol transformation, maybe not our case. The second template: retro_smarts_template '[C:3]-[C:2](-[C:4])-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(=C)-C(=O)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2](-[C:3])-[C:4]' This looks like reverse of carbonyl-ene? It transforms an alcohol to a carbonyl-ene? The forward reaction (canonical) is C-C(=C)-C(=O)-O-... to alcohol. That matches carbonyl-ene (break C=O to C-O, break C=C to C-C). So this template likely appropriate.
